cause: Native character meshes and weapons were retargeted, but damage capsules and melee queries stayed on the original gameplay skeleton.
fix: Bind existing head, torso and leg damage capsules to native Humanoid bones using rest-pose offsets and character size, preserving collider identities, enabled flags and damage ownership.
Query and sweep the visible sword pose for both contact damage and authoritative attack history; clear old sword samples when switching pose sources.
Update combat skeletons on skipped rendering frames and synchronize physics once after all native poses before late server-history and melee queries.
Restore authored capsule shapes and transforms when switching back to the default body.

baseline.reproduced: Visible-head points lay outside the original damage capsules; brute missed by 0.187708423 m at normal scale and 0.226331398 m at 1.2x scale.

coverage: Five native characters at 1x and 1.2x scale: visible head contact and authoritative body history.
PicoChan, Megumi, Security Officer and Casual 1 attacking Brute, plus Brute attacking PicoChan: actual HP damage, 1.5x head multiplier, no duplicate damage and rejection of off-blade server hits.
Attack and crouch poses at three phases: head, torso and leg collider alignment.
Character switching and restoration retain collider objects, parents, shapes and enabled states.
